harness.notes: sound.js has no imports. ctx() creates the AudioContext lazily inside the setInterval sequencer (step = 60/bpm/2, 32 notes per loop, drone every 4 steps). Sound defaults to on.

notes: All music is in js/sound.js TUNES (road 84 bpm, battle 150 bpm, town 96 bpm). Title screen reuses 'town'.
